summary: Eldorado Gold filed a 6-K with a news release announcing an executive leadership transition, not a routine matter. CEO George Burns will retire September 30, 2026, remaining on the board; Christian Milau becomes President and CEO and joins the board. Several other executives transition or depart, including Louw Smith leaving as Greece development role is eliminated. The changes reflect orderly succession planning, with no hostile or abrupt event apparent. The filing describes only management moves; no financial terms, advisors, or strategic review are mentioned. Watch for continued operational leadership stability as Skouries moves to production.
